actions.description: Runs python with the data input. Any prints will be returned.
actions.label: Shuffle_Tools_2
actions.name: execute_python

parameters.description: The code to run. Can be a file ID from within Shuffle.
parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import json
import time

raw = """$shuffle_tools_1"""
data = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else raw

ip = data.get("source_ip", "unknown")
alert_name = data.get("alert_name", "SOC Alert")
severity = data.get("severity", "low")
hostname = data.get("hostname", "unknown")
description = data.get("description", "")

severity_map = {"low": 1, "medium": 2, "high": 3, "critical": 4}
severity_int = severity_map.get(severity.lower(), 2)

ts = str(int(time.time()))
description_full = "Alert: " + alert_name + " | IP: " + ip + " | Host: " + hostname + " | " + description

thehive_body = json.dumps({
    "title": "[" + severity.upper() + "] " + alert_name + " - " + hostname,
    "description": description_full,
    "type": "external",
    "source": "Shuffle-SOC",
    "sourceRef": ip + "-" + ts,
    "severity": severity_int,
    "tags": ["SOC", "automated", "shuffle"]
})

case_body = json.dumps({
    "title": "[" + severity.upper() + "] " + alert_name + " - " + hostname,
    "description": description_full,
    "severity": severity_int,
    "tags": ["automated", "shuffle", "brute-force"],
    "tasks": [
        {"title": "Analyser IP source dans MISP"},
        {"title": "Verifier logs SSH sur " + hostname},
        {"title": "Bloquer IP via pfSense si confirme"},
        {"title": "Rediger rapport incident"}
    ]
})

print(json.dumps({"thehive_body": thehive_body, "case_body": case_body}))
